headlines.title_en: Li Qiang stresses during Shanghai research trip: accelerate cultivating and expanding emerging and future industries, continue to grow and strengthen advanced manufacturing
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, conducted research in Shanghai on September 22. He emphasized the need to thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing and the spirit of the National Conference on Advanced Manufacturing, adhere to the direction of intelligentization, greening, and integration, promote deep integration of technological innovation and industrial innovation, vigorously develop next-generation intelligent manufacturing, accelerate the cultivation and growth of emerging industries and future industries, and continue to expand and strengthen advanced manufacturing.

headlines.title_en: Zhang Guoqing: deepen whole-chain food safety regulation, improve regulatory quality and effectiveness through strict management and strict governance
headlines.summary_en: The main event of the 2026 National Food Safety Awareness Week was held in Beijing on the 22nd, with Zhang Guoqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attending and delivering a speech. Zhang Guoqing emphasized the need to strictly implement the "four strictest" requirements, persist in daily and routine strictness, and make greater efforts to ensure the implementation of full-chain food safety regulatory measures. It is necessary to fully compact and压实 responsibilities of all parties, strengthen seamless connection of supervision in all links including production, storage, transportation, and sales, urge production and operation entities to strictly control raw material access, product ex-factory, and full-process production and operation control, urge platform enterprises and testing and certification institutions to strictly fulfill their responsibilities, and ensure reliable food quality and safety.

headlines.title: 财政部发布《财政部关于加快推进会计数智化工作的指导意见（征求意见稿）》
headlines.summary: 《指导意见》征求意见稿主要包括以下内容：明确了加快推进会计数智化工作的指导思想、工作原则和总体目标。强化会计数智化法规制度机制保障。提出贯彻落实相关法规制度，完善会计相关制度规范，建立健全会计数智化建设评价机制与案例推广机制，夯实会计数智化工作的制度基础。加强会计数智化标准体系建设。部署健全完善会计核算数据标准、管理会计数据指标标准、内部控制报告数据标准、可持续信息披露数据标准、数字函证数据标准、注册会计师审计数据标准、会计数智化产品标准、加强会计数智化标准国际合作，构建系统完备的会计数智化标准体系。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance issues Guiding Opinions on Accelerating Accounting Digital and Intelligent Work (Draft for Comment)
headlines.summary_en: The draft for comments of the "Guiding Opinions" mainly includes the following contents: It clarifies the guiding ideology, working principles, and overall goals for accelerating the advancement of accounting digital-intelligence work. It strengthens the legal and institutional mechanism guarantees for accounting digital-intelligence. It proposes implementing relevant laws and regulations, improving accounting-related institutional norms, establishing and perfecting evaluation mechanisms and case promotion mechanisms for accounting digital-intelligence construction, and solidifying the institutional foundation for accounting digital-intelligence work. It strengthens the construction of accounting digital-intelligence standards system. It deploys the improvement of accounting calculation data standards, management accounting data indicator standards, internal control report data standards, sustainable information disclosure data standards, digital confirmation data standards, certified public accountant audit data standards, accounting digital-intelligence product standards, and strengthening international cooperation on accounting digital-intelligence standards, to build a systematic and comprehensive accounting digital-intelligence standards system.

headlines.title_en: China Huajun: currently in preliminary discussions with a certain party regarding a potential disposal
headlines.summary_en: China Huajun (0377.HK) announced in Hong Kong that the company noticed abnormal fluctuations in its share price today. After all inquiries reasonable under the current circumstances, the board confirmed that it is not aware of any reason causing the share price fluctuation, nor any information that must be announced to avoid a false market in the company's shares, or inside information that needs to be disclosed under Part XIVA of the Securities and Futures Ordinance. The board hereby informs that the company is currently in preliminary discussions with a certain party regarding a potential disposal matter. As of the date of this announcement, negotiations are still ongoing.

headlines.title: 千问办公将接入阿里云上的Salesforce
headlines.summary: 在2026云栖大会上，千问办公宣布将接入阿里云上的Salesforce（Salesforce on Alibaba Cloud）。此次接入，将结合千问办公的企业上下文理解、任务规划执行能力与Salesforce的客户管理能力，让企业员工能够在千问办公中查询销售商机、维护客户信息、推进业务流程，在日常办公中更便捷地处理客户管理与销售相关工作。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Qianwen Office to integrate with Salesforce on Alibaba Cloud
headlines.summary_en: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Qianwen Office announced that it will integrate with Salesforce on Alibaba Cloud. This integration will combine Qianwen Office's enterprise context understanding and task planning and execution capabilities with Salesforce's customer management capabilities, enabling enterprise employees to query sales opportunities, maintain customer information, and advance business processes within Qianwen Office, making it more convenient to handle customer management and sales-related work in daily office operations. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 万科A：近期公司经营情况稳定，内外部经营环境未发生重大变化
headlines.summary: 万科A发布异动公告，公司A股股票连续三个交易日收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过20%。根据《深圳证券交易所交易规则》及有关规定，属于股票交易异常波动。近期公司经营情况稳定，内外部经营环境未发生重大变化。公司在定期报告中已披露，2026年公司将聚焦化险和发展两大主题，坚定推进城市与业务聚焦，持续提升产品与服务能力，同时也将持续通过存量资源盘活和大宗资产交易，通过落实再融资、展期等融资优化举措，实现公司资债结构的优化、有序缓释到期偿付压力、稳妥处置债务风险。目前公司正持续推进相关工作。公司未发现近期公共传媒报道了可能或已经对公司股票交易价格产生较大影响的未公开重大

headlines.title_en: Vanke A: Company operations have been stable recently, no major changes in internal or external operating environment
headlines.summary_en: China Vanke A issued an abnormal fluctuation announcement that the closing price deviation of its A-shares exceeded 20% cumulatively over three consecutive trading days. According to the "Shenzhen Stock Exchange Trading Rules" and relevant provisions, this constitutes abnormal stock trading fluctuation. Recently, the company's operating conditions have been stable, and no major changes have occurred in the internal and external operating environment. The company has disclosed in its periodic reports that in 2026, the company will focus on the two major themes of risk resolution and development, firmly advance city and business focus, continuously improve product and service capabilities, and will also continue to optimize the company's asset-liability structure, orderly ease maturity repayment pressure, and properly handle debt risks through revitalizing existing resources and bulk asset transactions, and through implementing refinancing, extensions, and other financing optimization measures. Currently, the company is continuously advancing related work. The company has not found any undisclosed major information recently reported by public media that may or has already had a relatively large impact on the company's stock trading price.
